errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis categories are the models (Base, RMU, etc.). Furthermore, 'Forget Set' is not a model category but a visual pattern (hatching) applied to certain bars.
The description completely omits the labels for the main categories on the x-axis, which are 'WMDP-Bio', 'WMDP-Chem', and 'WMDP-Cyber'.
